# Version 4.159.0 (Unreleased)
> **Linux native asset realignment**

## Highlights

The next 4.159 release drops Linux x86 native assets. Linux applications using 32-bit x86 native packages will need to move to a supported architecture.

## Breaking Changes

- **Move Linux x86 applications to a supported architecture** — Linux x86 native builds and NuGet asset entries have been removed. Retarget applications that depend on those 32-bit assets to a supported Linux architecture, such as x64 or ARM64, before upgrading. ([#5784](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5784))
